paras: Zenker's worm snake (Letheobia zenkeri) is a species of snake in the family Typhlopidae. The species is native to Central Africa.
The specific name, zenkeri, is in honor of German botanist Georg August Zenker.
L. zenkeri is endemic to Cameroon.
L. zenkeri may attain a total length (including tail) of 12–13.5 centimetres (4.7–5.3 in). It has 18 scales around the body, and is "colourless" (farblos, in German).
